exit_code_contract: Documentary candidate 40..65 assigned uniquely, no executable binding; will require distinct human adoption before implementation
unrecognized_error: Exit/deny 99, never successful admission; no fallback
error_precedence: G0 > G1 > G2 > G3 > G4 > G5 > G6 > G7; within a gate choose lowest BR number; no risk of revealing reason to untrusted caller
atomicity: Unknown rollback/nonce durability BLOCKED; fail closed; no re-use of admission

breakers.trigger: Any attempt to open real monolithic ledger, disallowed file, cache or temp, even only for digest
breakers.expected_evidence: Future bounded synthetic negative-case ID and exact Git blob + canonical fixture hash + controlled stop-code with zero-side-effect counters; never raw rows, paths, keys, coefficients or predictions
breakers.red_oracle: Before handler implementation, a separately authorized isolated synthetic RED test must fail a genuine STOP assertion; not executed RD6-03A. For code outside RD6-03, BLOCKED until independent owner authorization.
breakers.green_oracle: After future separately authorized implementation, stop at G0_OWNER_AND_PROCESS_CAPABILITY with code UNAUTHORIZED_SOURCE_ACCESS before consumer can view unadmitted bytes; no forbidden downstream effect; deterministic replay, no fallback.
